en.text:
Precision Kills or two Precision Hits grants 'Roadborn' for 10 seconds. Additional Precision Hits add 3 seconds.

While 'Roadborn' is active, gain the following benefits:
• 22% increased Precision Damage
• 42% faster Rate of Fire
• 10% increased Damage Falloff distance (stacks with Intrinsic benefit, granting a total increase of 15%)
• 20 Stability
• 40 Reload Speed
• 25% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• 44% decreased Handling Animation Duration
